title: Where the loop's day went tells the truth about a stopped loop and a resumed walk run
goal: The daily digest reads the loop's day from one report and is told to call out any day with more than one whole-set walk run, since each costs about five hours. That report counts the short pick-up of a stopped run as a run of its own, so a day with one run in two parts and one new run reads as three, and the digest raises an alarm that is not real. It also counts a stopped loop as building: on 2026-10-28 it said the loop spent all 24 hours on one task, when the loop had been stopped since 04:45 the day before and no task ran at all.
notes: Seen by the a-full-walk-check-that-gets-stopped-picks-up-whe runner on 2026-10-22 (left rough: count reads one high) and again by the 2026-10-23 digest, which had to read queue/loop.log to find that the three runs were the 2026-10-22T11:15Z run stopped at 989 of 1011, its 7 minute pick-up (queue/sweep/2026-10-22-095234.log, 25 walks), and the 2026-10-23T11:41Z run stopped at 453 of 1015 when the person came back. Code: queue/bin/loop-day.mjs.
acceptance: Reproduce first: run node queue/bin/loop-day.mjs --hours 24 over the window ending 2026-10-23T14:02Z (or a drill that plants the same events) and record that it prints 3 full-set runs for the 2026-10-22 run, its 25-walk pick-up, and the 2026-10-23 run
A pick-up that finishes a stopped run is counted with the run it finishes (its minutes still count), so that window reads 2 runs, and the line says when a run was finished in parts
A run stopped part way and not yet picked up says so beside the count
A drill covers both cases and runs with the other sweep drills

A task handed back unfinished (task_pending) or a loop that stops or restarts (loop_started, and a loop that died with no line) ends the task's time. Reproduce first: node queue/bin/loop-day.mjs --since 2026-10-27T14:20:42Z --until 2026-10-28T14:20:42Z printed 'tasks 1440m 100.0% 1 task(s)' on 2026-10-28, from painting-is-what-you-see-earlier-strokes-never-r's task_started at 2026-10-27T10:15:29Z, its task_pending at 11:37:19Z, and the loop dying in the 11:38Z rotating check with nothing after it until loop_started at 2026-10-28T14:19:59Z. Fixed, that window reads 0 minutes on tasks and the line says the loop was not running for most of it

log.note: triage 2026-10-28, folded in: the report also counts a dead loop as building. Ran node queue/bin/loop-day.mjs --hours 24 at 2026-10-28T14:20Z and it printed 'tasks 1440m 100.0% 1 task(s) ... The loop spent the majority of this window building', yet no task ran in that window: the last task_started was 2026-10-27T10:15:29Z, it went back to pending at 11:37:19Z, the loop died during the 11:38Z rotating check (queue/sweep/slice-2026-10-27-043801.log stops mid-walk at crisp-zoom-walk, no stop line in queue/loop.log) and the next event is loop_started at 2026-10-28T14:19:59Z. spansFrom in loop-day.mjs ends a task only on task_done, task_blocked, task_dropped, task_reset, runner_failed or the next start; task_pending and loop_started are not ends, so the span ran to now. The digest is told to quote this number, so it read the day upside down.

triage 2026-10-29, reproduced again: 'node queue/bin/loop-day.mjs --hours 24' at 2026-10-30T02:08Z printed 'tasks 1440m 100.0% 1 task(s) ... The loop spent the majority of this window building'. The loop was stopped by hand on 2026-10-28 at 08:41 Mac time (the photo task's log says so) and not started again until 2026-10-29 18:55, so no task ran for any of that window. Second digest in a row whose day report is wrong for this reason.

triage 2026-10-31: today's report was right, because the loop ran the whole window: it said tasks 1194m, and summing task_started to task_pending/done spans in queue/history.jsonl over the same window gives 1185m. The stopped-loop case is still unfixed and will show again the next time the loop is stopped.

digest 2026-11-02: seen again. loop-day.mjs --hours 24 said 'sweeps 471m, 4 full-set run(s)'. The history shows one complete run (sweep_pass 12:11Z, 1081 walks, 415 min) and three starts put down when the person came back (21:37Z 9 walks, 22:57Z the pick-up of that one, 84 more, and 23:48Z 97 walks). Two of the four restarted from walk one because code had landed after a stop, under a --now request. A reader of the digest is told 'four whole-set runs' when the day had one.

digest 2026-11-05: same family, wrong reason on the dashboard. The 2026-11-05 run was stopped because somebody came back to the Mac (loop.log: Somebody is using the Mac), and the block on the standing walk task says the run was interrupted because whoever was running it went away. That wording comes from queue-lib.mjs near line 1648 and was written for a killed loop. Make it name the real reason when the fix here lands.
